title: Chapter 318: Eight-Star Zerg Mother Nest
content:
Chapter 318: Eight-Star Zerg Mother Nest

In the main city of the alien race in the 108th area of the public battlefield in the southern theater, the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions outside the city began to approach the main city and hid underground in batches.

The main combat forces of the nearly five million Zerg army, except for a small number of soldiers in very good condition who attacked, all other soldiers entered the rest state.

The flying speed of the Zerg air force was very fast, and soon entered the lord protection range of the main city of the alien race. There were not many people from all forces who wanted to follow the Zerg air force.

Those who could keep up with the speed of the Zerg air force were the real elites of all races.

The alien race also discovered a large number of Zerg air forces coming to help through various reconnaissance methods, and the atmosphere in the entire alien race main city became tense.

The Zerg air force, which numbered more than 10 million, flew to the main city of the alien race without delay, and joined the more than 1 million Zerg air forces that were attacking, and launched a full-scale attack.

More than 200,000 five-star Zerg air guards opened a long line and launched a fierce attack on the deep targets of the alien race's main city.

More than 500,000 Zerg destroyers began to fire at full power and fired at the target area that had been locked for a long time.

"Boom boom..." The explosion sounded everywhere in the alien race's main city, and a large number of alien race troops' defensive positions were attacked fiercely.

With so many days of preparation time, the entire alien race's main city has been reinforced into a more solid fortress city. The attacks of those weaker Zerg destroyers can no longer hit many solid bunkers.

However, this trick is not very useful for the Zerg. As long as the enemy dares not come out, the Zerg ground forces will soon follow.

Every move of the alien race's main city is under the surveillance of the Zerg host. For those threatening targets, the five-star Zerg air guards will use a single-point attack mode to concentrate firepower to destroy the target.

At the beginning, the Zerg army had few targets to attack. Under the continuous attacks of the Zerg army in recent days, the aliens deployed their troops in areas far away from the main Zerg combat forces.

With the ultra-long-range firepower of the Zerg army, the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions began to advance into the main city of the aliens.

Nearly a thousand six-star Zerg scorpions began to release black bees, forming a black fog composed of micro-insects in the area of the main combat forces of the Zerg army and the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions at the forefront, providing the Zerg army with powerful protection similar to the Zerg field.

The main combat forces of the Zerg, according to the offensive route formulated by the Queen, advanced all the way to the central urban area of the main city of the aliens. The closer to the central urban area of the main city of the aliens, the greater the resistance the Zerg army encountered.

According to the characteristics of each branch of the Zerg army, the alien army made a large number of targeted deployments to kill as many Zerg troops as possible and block the Zerg army's attack.

However, any normal means of combat in this world would not be effective against the Zerg army. The combat power of each branch of the Zerg army is the best among the same type of branches. Different branches cooperate well with each other and are not afraid of the enemy's targeting.

The various deployments of the alien army did not play a greater role except slowing down the attack speed of the Zerg army.

If the aliens only had these means, the Zerg army would only need to spend some time to push the main city.

"The conventional combat power of the Zerg army is indeed beyond common sense. Looking at the armies of various tribes, there is no one who can compete with it!"

"This battle is particularly important to the alien race. It is not ruled out that they will send a large number of strong men to participate in the battle!"

"Should we be prepared? So as not to be caught off guard by them?"

"We all have some strong men nearby, who can help the Zerg when necessary!"

"Maybe we don't need to participate in the battle. Since the Zerg has such a powerful conventional army, it must not lack strong men!"

"I hope so. It would be best if we don't participate in the battle!"

"Everyone should prepare for the worst. Let's wait and see!"

"..."

The major tribes in the local camp sent important figures to watch the battle. They gathered together to exchange views on the situation on the battlefield.

According to the battlefield intelligence provided by the Zerg host, there is no strong man with a strength of more than six stars in the entire alien race main city.

Wu Qing understood the reason why the alien race withdrew all the strong men. The Zerg army killed thousands of seven-star strong men from the evil god camp on the battlefield yesterday, which made the alien race dare not put seven-star strong men on this battlefield again.

The seven-star strong men have been proven in actual combat that they are useless on such a battlefield.

Whether the strong men with eight stars and above will participate in the war, because the Zerg army launched this important war right after yesterday's war, and the alien race has not yet discussed the specific results.

This made the battlefield of the entire alien race main city without the presence of the strong men of the alien race and other evil god camp races.

The Zerg army gradually attacked the key defense area of the alien army, where the alien army has a lot of troops.

The six-star Zerg scorpion began to create a plague area, and the six-star Zerg mammoth joined the charge team, leading the Zerg puppy forward, keeping up with the advancement speed of the Zerg army's long-range firepower, and clearing the remaining enemies.

The same number of six-star Zerg queens began to parasitize and control the powerful arms of the alien army, launching attacks from within the alien army to create chaos.

The combat power of each arm of the Zerg army is fully opened, except for the seven-star arms, all arms are involved in the battle.

"Pay attention!"

Wu Qing has transported the seven-star Zerg arms to the area of the space transmission channel in the main city of the aliens through the transport-type Zerg host, and included all the space transmission channels in the attack range of the seven-star Zerg queen and the seven-star Zerg scorpion.

The queen personally controlled the Zerg host and kept a close eye on the various space transmission channels in the main city of the aliens.

Suddenly, nearly thirty powerful men with terrifying momentum appeared in a space transmission channel in the main city of the aliens, especially the alien strongman who led the team, who had a momentum that stood out from the crowd.

As soon as this group of strong men appeared, they were about to launch an attack, and the energy between heaven and earth instantly vibrated.

The seven-star Zerg Queen and the seven-star Zerg Scorpion, who had been on high alert, immediately launched an attack. The Zerg Queen's spawning and the Zerg Scorpion's elimination respectively hit those strong men, including the strongest alien strong man.

The seven-star Zerg Scorpion's elimination hit the alien strong man, and for the first time, the rule-level attack judgment failed. The alien strong man did not disappear like other strong men.

"A strong man with nine-star strength!"

Wu Qing confirmed the true strength of the alien strong man.

A seven-star Zerg Queen who did not participate in the attack immediately launched an spawning attack on the nine-star alien strong man.

Although the Zerg Queen's spawning attack cannot kill enemies across two levels, it can hatch self-destructing parasites in the enemy's body, interfere with the enemy's actions, and prevent the powerful enemy from launching an attack for a certain period of time.

Sure enough, the nine-star-strength alien warrior was caught in the action of clearing the self-destructing parasites in his body after being attacked by the seven-star Zerg Queen, and he could not take care of other things.

In this team of warriors, except for one nine-star warrior, the others were all eight-star warriors.

The aliens were gambling on whether the Zerg had the ability to kill the eight-star warriors with one blow.

If they won the bet, the dilemma of the aliens would be solved. If they lost the bet, they would have to make a bigger bet.

When the first eight-star warrior in the alien camp was killed by the seven-star Zerg scorpion, Wu Qing's consciousness instantly returned to his body standing outside the Zerg mother nest.

"Upgrade to eight-star!"

Wu Qing quickly chose the Zerg mother nest to upgrade to eight-star.

The Zerg mother nest entered the upgrade state.

On the battlefield of the alien city, another seven-star Zerg queen launched an egg-laying attack on the nine-star alien warrior who was about to escape.

Under the intervention of the rule-level power, another self-destructing parasite hatched and grew in the body of the nine-star alien race strongman, and then was also suppressed by the nine-star power and could not grow quickly.

The seven-star Zerg queen bought time for the upgrade of the Zerg mother nest, and the Zerg mother nest was finally successfully upgraded to eight stars.

On the battlefield of the alien race main city, a seven-star Zerg scorpion immediately pupated and entered the upgrade state.
